checkpoints.description: [1/4] Execute authored boss phase abilities: forgotten_army summons echoes, void_domain/true_ending ring projectiles, timeline_shift teleports safely, reconstruction_beam fires a spread; [2/4] Balance/guards: exclude bosses from random elites, count a run completion once until death, clear inventory on permadeath; [3/4] Extract victory summary into a pure tested helper; [4/4] ADR/docs/tests/7-gate check

impact_assessment.why: Verification found boss phase abilities were announced but never executed, elite multipliers could stack on bosses, completedRuns could be farmed without dying, permadeath left run loot in inventory, and victory formatting was only DOM-covered
impact_assessment.benefits: Boss phases now change the fight, deep bosses stay hand-tuned instead of randomly elite, run completion and permadeath semantics are enforceable, and victory data is unit-testable
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new combat:bossAbility event and pure victorySummary module; dependency: none; concurrency: no other writer; state: runCompleted flag and inventory reset must not wipe meta stats
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep ability effects deterministic, guard teleport with solid-tile checks, test phase ability counts/projectiles, elite exclusion, runCompletion guard, permadeath inventory reset and victory summary, then rerun all gates

checkpoints.description: [milestones 1-3/4] Boss phase abilities execute (summons, rings, teleport, spread); bosses excluded from random elites; run completion guarded once per run; permadeath clears run inventory; victory summary extracted and tested; collection snapshots prevent phase-spawned minions being hit by the triggering swing. 97 tests. checklists: passed

Final verification: DoT phase transitions, entity-loop snapshot, serialized runCompleted guard, and keeper phase ability tests (timeline_shift, reconstruction_beam, true_ending). 100 tests, 7/7 gates, diff check clean. checklists: passed

[1/4] Add GitHub Actions CI for npm ci, lint, test, typecheck and build; [2/4] Bring the in-game tutorial in line with the current combat/run mechanics; [3/4] Add content-data integrity tests for enemies/items/loot/phase/elite invariants; [4/4] Docs/ADR and full gate check

impact_assessment.why: The project has no CI, the onboarding text still describes radial slashes, and content JSON is only validated indirectly by whichever code happens to import it
impact_assessment.benefits: Every push gets an objective quality gate, new players learn the actual mechanics, and broken loot/phase/stats data fails tests before it reaches playtests
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new tests only, CI workflow; dependency: none; concurrency: no other writer; state: no runtime state changes
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep the CI workflow on the declared Node engine, test only authored data invariants, and rerun all local gates

[1/2] Item use/equip: useItem heals/restores/invincibility/converts memory/unlocks abilities; equipItem/unequipSlot with weapon/armor/accessory slots and equipment-aware derived stats; equipment serialized and cleared by permadeath; inventory overlay with Use/Equip/Unequip actions and live refresh; [2/2] docs/ADR-013 and full gates. 110 tests.

impact_assessment.why: Loot tables produced equipment and consumables that could not be used, making the loot loop dead weight and the tutorial dishonest
impact_assessment.benefits: Dropped items now change the next fight, equipment persists across saves, and permadeath cleanly removes run gear
impact_assessment.risks: contract: EquipmentState, use/equip APIs, inventory events; dependency: MenuSystem now depends on playerSystem; concurrency: no other writer; state: equipment and inventory serialize, unsimulated item stats remain stored but inactive
impact_assessment.mitigation: Unit-test consumption, stat application/removal, save round-trip and permadeath clearing; keep UI DOM-only; rerun all gates

[1/2] Add deterministic balance duel harness (tests/balance.test.ts) with TTK/damage/hit metrics and BALANCE_REPORT matrix; [2/2] Fix light knockback cancelling every windup, add configurable meleeOffset/meleeRange (20+35), update docs/ADR-014 and regressions. 117 tests.

impact_assessment.why: Balance was tuned by intuition; a deterministic duel matrix was needed to catch melee enemies never damaging a stationary player
impact_assessment.benefits: Repeated, seed-stable TTK/damage metrics; melee enemies now complete windups and threaten the player; reach is configurable instead of hardcoded
impact_assessment.risks: contract: combat.meleeOffset/meleeRange and windup interrupt semantics; dependency: none; concurrency: no other writer; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Lock behavior with light-hit, heavy-hit, scavenger, determinism and Keeper tests; document stationary-duel limits; rerun all gates
